components.name: Workspace Row
components.description: A single title-only source-list row using system selection.
components.css: .ds-workspace-row { width: 240px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: Highlight; color: HighlightText; font: 13px system-ui; text-align: left; } .ds-workspace-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid -webkit-focus-ring-color; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Selected Tab
components.description: A compact native-looking selected tab with an adjacent close action.
components.css: .ds-tab-wrap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font: 12px system-ui; } .ds-tab { min-width: 112px; max-width: 160px; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid GrayText; border-radius: 5px; background: ButtonFace; color: ButtonText; text-align: left; } .ds-tab:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-tab:focus-visible, .ds-tab-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid -webkit-focus-ring-color; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-tab-close { border: 0; background: transparent; color: CanvasText; font: 14px system-ui; }

components.name: Browser Address
components.description: A single compact address field beside native browser actions.
components.css: .ds-address { width: 420px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid GrayText; border-radius: 6px; background: Field; color: FieldText; font: 13px system-ui; } .ds-address:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid -webkit-focus-ring-color; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-address:disabled { opacity: 0.55; }

components.name: Terminal Pane
components.description: An edge-to-edge terminal surface with one quiet pane-actions control.
components.css: .ds-terminal { position: relative; min-width: 420px; min-height: 220px; padding: 8px; background: #000; color: #f5f5f5; font: 13px ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-pane-menu { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #d0d0d0; } .ds-pane-menu:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-pane-menu:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid -webkit-focus-ring-color; }

narrative.overview: MyTerm should feel like a dependable part of macOS: dense, direct, and quiet enough to disappear while work is happening. The hierarchy comes from familiar system structure, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Large uninterrupted terminal and browser surfaces

rules.name: System Owns the Palette
rules.body: Do not freeze native backgrounds, labels, separators, focus rings, or selection colors into custom hex values.

rules.name: Terminal Owns Mono
rules.body: Do not spread monospaced type into navigation or general controls to make the app look more technical.

rules.name: Working Surface
rules.body: Terminal and browser content should remain visually dominant, with chrome separated by structure rather than floating cards.

dos: Do keep workspaces scannable by title alone.
Do use native macOS controls, semantic appearance, focus, menus, accessibility, and splitters.
Do keep the tab row compact at 26 pt and scroll it when tabs exceed the available width.
Do preserve a large, uninterrupted content surface.
Do provide both a visible route and a keyboard route for frequent actions.
Do make visible focus and VoiceOver labels part of the component contract.
donts: Don't copy cmux's notifications, agent status, colored workspace metadata, or other features outside the requested workflow.
Don't use decorative terminal chrome, novelty controls, or motion that interrupts focused work.
Don't build terminal rendering on web technology when a native implementation is available.
Don't turn workspaces, tabs, or terminal panes into floating cards.
Don't use custom fixed colors where macOS already provides an adaptive semantic role.
Don't let browser controls or navigation chrome compete with the active terminal or page.
